items.title: Sound perception and word recognition
items.expectation: Use phonological cues to recognise familiar connected speech despite regular variation and first-language influence.
items.exit_boundary: Generally intelligible despite regular mispronunciation and noticeable first-language influence.

items.title: Consonant contrasts and place or manner clarity
items.expectation: Keep consonant distinctions generally intelligible in connected familiar-topic speech despite regular mispronunciation.
items.exit_boundary: Generally intelligible despite regular mispronunciation and noticeable first-language influence.

items.title: Vowel contrasts and reduced vowels
items.expectation: Keep vowel quality sufficiently distinct in connected familiar-topic speech despite noticeable accent.
items.exit_boundary: Generally intelligible despite regular mispronunciation and noticeable first-language influence.

items.title: Syllable shape, consonant clusters, and word endings
items.expectation: Maintain word shape across longer familiar-topic stretches while self-correcting important cluster problems.
items.exit_boundary: Generally intelligible despite regular mispronunciation and noticeable first-language influence.

items.title: Audible grammatical endings
items.expectation: Preserve grammatical endings consistently enough in connected speech for time, number, and ownership to remain clear.
items.exit_boundary: Generally intelligible despite regular mispronunciation and noticeable first-language influence.

items.title: Word stress and stress-sensitive recognition
items.expectation: Maintain generally intelligible word stress across familiar connected speech and repair important errors.
items.exit_boundary: Generally intelligible despite regular mispronunciation and noticeable first-language influence.

items.title: Sentence prominence and rhythm
items.expectation: Use prominence to keep main information clear in connected familiar-topic speech.
items.exit_boundary: Generally intelligible despite regular mispronunciation and noticeable first-language influence.

items.title: Connected-speech perception and production
items.expectation: Process familiar connected speech and use linking or reduction that supports rather than obscures meaning.
items.exit_boundary: Generally intelligible despite regular mispronunciation and noticeable first-language influence.

items.title: Intonation, interaction, and stance
items.expectation: Use intonation to signal main intent, involvement, contrast, and completion in familiar interaction.
items.exit_boundary: Generally intelligible despite regular mispronunciation and noticeable first-language influence.

items.title: Chunking, pausing, monitoring, and pronunciation repair
items.expectation: Chunk connected familiar-topic speech and monitor or repair pronunciation without abandoning the message.
items.exit_boundary: Generally intelligible despite regular mispronunciation and noticeable first-language influence.
